subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3565
title: Allows the siting and operation of a small modular reactor energy facility without requiring that there be a licensed repository for the disposal of high-level radioactive waste or that the proposed site certificate for the small modular reactor energy facility be submitted to the electors of this state for their approval or rejection.
headline: HB 3565 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3565 was introduced in the House on February 18, 2025.
HB 3565 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
